name: department-copilots
description: Local-only department copilots for staff. Employees paste or drop their own inputs; Claude analyses them locally and returns drafts, checklists, reviews and decision aids. No CRM, NMS, email or system integrations.

plugins.name: copilot-common
plugins.description: Shared rules and readers used by every department copilot: privacy rules, document/spreadsheet/screenshot readers, writing helper.

plugins.name: sticky-notes
plugins.description: Personal local memory: capture notes, actions and context bundles as plain Markdown files on your own machine.

plugins.name: noc
plugins.description: NOC Copilot: fault-domain analysis, next checks and ticket notes from pasted CLI output, alarms and screenshots.

plugins.name: network-engineering
plugins.description: Network Engineer: config review, change validation, routing analysis and troubleshooting from pasted configs and logs.

plugins.name: network-design
plugins.description: Design Reviewer: finds inconsistencies, missing elements and BOM mismatches in design drawings, notes and BOMs.

plugins.name: field-ops
plugins.description: Field Assistant: interprets optical and test results, suggests the next test and writes site close-out notes.

plugins.name: construction
plugins.description: Construction Copilot: defect prioritisation, blocker analysis, contractor instructions and progress summaries.

plugins.name: project-delivery
plugins.description: Project Copilot: finds blockers, dependencies, risks, actions and decisions in meeting notes, schedules and RAID logs.

plugins.name: customer-ops
plugins.description: Customer Case Assistant: summarises cases, finds missing information and drafts professional customer responses.

plugins.name: rsp
plugins.description: RSP Assistant: works out what to ask the RSP and drafts technically accurate wholesale responses.

plugins.name: business-development
plugins.description: BD Copilot: account briefs, meeting prep, opportunity analysis, proposal writing and follow-up plans.

plugins.name: developer-relations
plugins.description: Developer Assistant: requirements summaries, open items, stakeholder questions and handover prep for property developments.

plugins.name: finance
plugins.description: Finance Reviewer: variance analysis, invoice vs PO checks, reconciliations and commentary drafts from exported files.

plugins.name: procurement
plugins.description: Procurement Assistant: quote comparison, BOM comparison, supplier assessment and reorder planning.

plugins.name: warehouse
plugins.description: Warehouse Assistant: stock analysis, shortages, slow movers, duplicates and replenishment recommendations from stock exports.

plugins.name: people
plugins.description: People Assistant: interview questions, JD improvement, structured interview summaries, onboarding plans and policy explanations.

plugins.name: marketing
plugins.description: Marketing Copilot: copy improvement, audience variants, headlines, proofing and FAQ generation.

plugins.name: compliance
plugins.description: Compliance Reviewer: obligations, risks, dates, ambiguities and questions for legal from policies, contracts and procedures.

plugins.name: security
plugins.description: Security Analyst: triage, investigation checklists and remediation guidance from pasted logs, alerts and config excerpts.

plugins.name: analytics
plugins.description: Data Analyst: profiles CSV/XLSX exports, finds anomalies, duplicates, outliers and trends and explains them plainly.

plugins.name: executive
plugins.description: Executive Briefing: converts reports, notes and spreadsheets into decisions, risks, priorities and executive briefs.

plugins.name: training
plugins.description: Learning Coach: turns SOPs and manuals into explanations, quizzes, fault scenarios and personalised training.
